# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short:

- Be respectful and welcoming. Assume good intent; critique code, not people.
- No harassment, insults, discriminatory language or personal attacks.
- No sharing of game files, keys, dumps or piracy links — this protects the project and everyone in it.
- Keep discussions on topic; use GitHub Discussions for questions and ideas.

Problems can be reported privately to the maintainer through the contact listed on the maintainer's GitHub profile. Reports are handled confidentially. The maintainer may remove content and block participants who violate this code.

---

本项目遵循 [Contributor Covenant 2.1 版](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/zh-cn/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)。简要来说：尊重他人、对事不对人；禁止骚扰、辱骂、歧视和人身攻击；禁止分享游戏文件、密钥、导出内容或盗版链接；讨论保持主题相关。违规问题可通过维护者 GitHub 主页上的联系方式私下报告，维护者会保密处理，并可删除违规内容、封禁违规者。
